fields.description: This handmade wood pendant light combines contemporary industrial design with a mid-century modern feeling. What is so unique about this lamp is the fact that it creates streams of shadow and light on the ceiling and walls. The stronger the light, the bigger the casting shadows. UMBRELLA has everything you need to change your whole home decor. With its mid-century design and warm illumination, this light fixture is the ideal accent to any living area, creating a comfortable and welcoming ambiance. All umbrella pendant lights come with gold pins, which convey a refined finish and a touch of luxury. Each of our wood chandelier lights comes with our handmade wooden ceiling cup. All our wood light fixtures have been carefully created by us, in our family workshop in Greece, using sustainable wood and promoting environmentally friendly practices.
